newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sega says sold 1.2 mln Saturn players in Apr-Oct.
newsitem.headline: Sega says sold 1.2 mln Saturn players in Apr-Oct.

text.p: Sega Enterprises Ltd said on Friday that it sold 1.2 million units of its Sega Saturn videogame players in Japan between April and October.
"We are smoothly achieving our target of selling 2.5 million Sega Saturns in Japan by the end of next March," Sega vice president Shoichiro Irimajiri told a news conference.
Sega will aim to sell one million Saturns during this Christmas/New Year season, he said.
Some industry analysts have said that achieving this annual sales target, which Sega set earlier this year, would be difficult.
They expect Nintendo Co Ltd's N64 videogame players and Sony Corp's PlayStations to dominate the Japanese market and put Saturn out of the running.
